findings.note: The advisory/required byte-identity criterion is unsatisfied and internally impossible as written. capability_enforcement is embedded in the canonical Project Context and Context Projection, so changing it necessarily changes full_context_revision and projection_sha256 in context_binding, not only Resolver Evidence.state. The implementation report explicitly acknowledges this unresolved conflict.

T-004 promises a staged-only steps-10–13 implementation with no live-path writes before T-007 adds step 14, but every Block calls _write_evidence, which creates specs/<feature>, writes a temporary file, fsyncs it, and replaces the live resolver-evidence.yaml directly without the required journaled publication transaction.

Governing-schema handling does not fully preserve the closed Block taxonomy. UTF-8 decoding failures are not caught by _load_governing_schema, and malformed internal $ref structures can raise uncaught KeyError/ValueError during validation, producing a traceback instead of contract-discovery-failed or output-schema-validation-failed with canonical evidence.
